from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Captures the essential legal attributes of a single court document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the judgment document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The specific document type, e.g., '判决书', '裁定书'")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action or legal reason for the case")
    proceeding_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural stage, e.g., '执行', '审判', '再审'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase]
